work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letters CCLVIII (numeral OCR CCLVUL) approve the priory of the Order of SS. Maurice and Lazarus at Torre Pellice/Luserna for missions among the Pinerolo valleys and unite to it the parish and vicariate; the page-388 running title LF56971 before the numeral is excluded; LF57036 → LF57045 across own provenance LF57039 and running title LF57042; LF57103 → LF57109 across page number 389 LF57106; complete 3 December 1839 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF56985–56985; the source closing at LF57144–57147 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Mariam Maiorem sub annulo piscatoris die tertia decembris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo nono, pontificatus No- stri anno nono. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
